newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to offer A$800 mln in T-bonds.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to offer A$800 mln in T-bonds.

text.p: The Treasury will offer a total of A$800 million in Treasury bonds through a tender on Tuesday, including a new line of 2009 stock, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said.
The offering will comprise A$600 million in the new line of 7.5 percent September 2009 bonds and A$200 million in the established 9.75 percent bonds maturing in March 2002.
The Reserve Bank said it would take up an additional A$200 million in the new 2009 bonds.
The bank said bids would be received until 12.45 pm. (0145 GMT) on Tuesday and results will be announced at 2.00 p.m. (0300 GMT). Settlement date is October 31.
